economicActivity.label: Coca-Cola system economic activity
economicActivity.definition: Modeled contribution to GDP (value added) of The Coca-Cola Company plus its independent U.S. bottlers ("the Coca-Cola system"), including suppliers, distributors, retailers and re-spending of wages, from a Multi-Regional Input-Output model by consultancy Steward Redqueen. Published rounded ($2B, $443M); values in millions are converted to billions in the bracketed note.

jobsSupported.label: Jobs supported by the Coca-Cola system
jobsSupported.definition: Direct, supplier, value-chain and induced jobs the Coca-Cola system supports in the state, modeled by Steward Redqueen; published rounded as "23K+".

directEmployees.label: Direct Coca-Cola system employees
directEmployees.definition: Direct employees of The Coca-Cola Company and its independent bottlers in the state, per the study; published rounded as "3K+". Most are bottler employees, not TCCC employees.

employees.label: Company employees
employees.definition: Employees of The Coca-Cola Company located in the country (approximately)

concentratePlantsOwned.label: Principal concentrate and/or syrup plants, owned
concentratePlantsOwned.definition: Owned principal concentrate and/or syrup plants in the operating segment

concentratePlantsLeased.label: Principal concentrate and/or syrup plants, leased
concentratePlantsLeased.definition: Leased principal concentrate and/or syrup plants in the operating segment

bottlingPlantsOwned.label: Principal beverage manufacturing/bottling plants, owned
bottlingPlantsOwned.definition: Owned principal beverage manufacturing/bottling plants in the operating segment (company-owned only; independent bottlers' plants are not included)

bottlingPlantsLeased.label: Principal beverage manufacturing/bottling plants, leased
bottlingPlantsLeased.definition: Leased principal beverage manufacturing/bottling plants in the operating segment

sites.name: Worldwide headquarters
sites.description: Our worldwide headquarters is located on a 35-acre complex in Atlanta, Georgia.

source.label: The Coca-Cola Company Form 10-K for fiscal 2025, Item 2. Properties
source.quote: Our worldwide headquarters is located on a 35-acre complex in Atlanta, Georgia. The complex includes several office buildings which are used by Corporate employees and North America operating segment employees.

notes: State rows come from The Coca-Cola Company's U.S. Economic & Community Impact map (company-hosted table for 50 states, DC, Puerto Rico and cities), a study by consultancy Steward Redqueen ("Steward Redqueen 2026 Assessment"; "reflective of the calendar year 2025"), so tier is company-commissioned. No newer edition found (checked Nov 24, 2026): the live map still shows the same figures for all 51 rows. The study attribution and the 'calendar year 2025' wording are carried over from the earlier fetch; they are not in the HTML served on Nov 24, 2026, which holds only the table. An earlier Steward Redqueen study covered 2022 ($57.8B nationally, press release Sept 2023), but its state figures are no longer published. All state figures cover the whole Coca-Cola system (TCCC plus independent bottlers), not the company alone, and are rounded by the source; Puerto Rico and city rows are left out; goods-and-services purchased and community investment columns not recorded. Regions: the FY2025 10-K facility table by operating segment (Dec 31, 2025); only the four geographic segments are recorded (the 10-K now labels the first one 'EMEA'). Bottling Investments (56 owned and 5 leased bottling plants) and Corporate are not geographic and are left out; the FY2025 table no longer has a Global Ventures row, and its 1,379 leased retail stores now sit in the EMEA row; distribution, storage and retail columns are not recorded. U.S. company employees approximately 8,900 of ~65,900 total at Dec 31, 2025 (10-K; the decrease is attributed to 2025 divestitures). No employees-by-state or taxes-by-country found.
